Join Host @countdowntoclassic, Senior Game Designer Josh “Aggrend” Greenfield, Lore Historian Lead & Birthday Haver Sean Copeland, and special guests Platinum WoW & Nobbel87 for an all-out nerdfest digging into the inspiration behind WoW: Forever’s lore and its implications for the future. 

Thank you to the Secret Finding Community for inspiration and ideas about our background board.
